```{python}
#| include: false

import ast
from inspect import getsource
from textwrap import dedent

def show_code(function, *steps):
    source = getsource(function)
    if steps:
        statements = {}
        for statement in ast.parse(source).body[0].body:
            if isinstance(statement, ast.Assign) and isinstance(statement.targets[0], ast.Name):
                statements[statement.targets[0].id] = statement
            elif isinstance(statement, ast.Return):
                statements["return"] = statement
        source = "\n".join(
            dedent(ast.get_source_segment(source, statements[step], padded=True))
            for step in steps
        )
    print(f"```python\n{source.rstrip()}\n```")
```
